report_comment.text: CRTC1 encodes a coactivator of CREB-dependent transcription. MAML2 encodes a transcriptional coactivator in Notch signaling. The fusion links a CRTC CREB-binding region to the MAML2 activation domain, causing constitutive recruitment of CBP/p300 and abnormal CREB-dependent transcription. It is a recurrent driver of mucoepidermoid carcinoma. In a153-patient salivary mucoepidermoid carcinoma cohort, CRTC1/3::MAML2 fusion positivity was associated with better overall survival in the total and advanced-stage groups, with no observed disease-free-survival benefit.
